maria: Quick heads-up 17:30 UTC staging slate. Need a short internal RN and a pin; confirm rollback guardrails. @sam @sylvia

maria: Draft RN snippet:
```
Staging deploy (db-8341) 17:30 UTC 024-08-21
- What: inference kernels + refined quant profile. Expect ~15% median latency win on long-context flows and small embedding token cost drop. No API changes.
- Rollout: 10% canary for 10m -> 100% if health checks pass.
- Auto-rollback: fallback to model-v1.10-quant if error rate >3% sustained for 5m or sudden latency spike.
```

sam: OK. Curious if we should do 10/50/100 ramp — 10->100 is faster but riskier.

maria: Prefer 10->100 after 10m; we want a quick signal and faster validation.

deploy-bot: @maria scheduled deploy job db-8341 for 2024-08-21T17:30:00Z status: pending. Will update status hops here.

sylvia: Copy nit: change "median latency win" -> "median latency improvement". Also mark "Internal only" at the top. Add verify steps for eng.

evan: Internal announce draft (two bullets + verify):
```
Internal only: staging rollout 17:30 UTC (db-8341)
- What: kernels + quant profile update; expect ~15% p50 improvement on long-context; lower embedding token cost.
- Verify: check rollout dashboard p50/p95 and run `curl -s https://staging-api.internal/health | jq .latency.p50`.
- Rollback: auto-fallback to model-v1.10-quant on >3% failures sustained 5m; manual rollback by oncall.
Ping @oncall-lisa if you see anomalies.
```

oncall-lisa: I'll be on standby 17:15-18:00 UTC and assigned to db-8341. My manual rollback trigger: sustained 5xx >0.8% for 5m or p95 latency >2s.

maria: Thanks. Making the copy edits, marking internal-only, and pinning RN to #eng-releases now.

sam: I'll watch metrics during the canary and be ready to help with rollback if needed.

sylvia: LGTM. No external comms today.

deploy-bot: db-8341 update: queued -> started at 2024-08-21T17:30:12Z. Progress will post here.

maria: Closing thread; will reopen if rollback or unexpected behavior occurs.
